Umm al-Qura calendar

Dates use the Umm al-Qura calendar — Saudi Arabia’s official calendar — from 1300 to 1600 AH.

Good to know

Ramadan and Eid are set by moon sighting, so they can differ from the calendar by a day.

Two calendars, one view

The Hijri year follows the moon: its months have 29 or 30 days, so it’s about 11 days shorter than the Gregorian year. That’s why Ramadan moves earlier every year and travels through all the seasons over about 33 years. The calendar below shows both side by side for any month.
